transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, you're through to Marcus. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. An engineer was meant to come today between eight and twelve and nobody turned up. I took the day off work for this and I'm really fed up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm really sorry, Tobias, losing a day off for nothing is incredibly frustrating, and you shouldn't have been left waiting. I'll find out what happened and make sure it's put right. Could you give me your account PIN first?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. So you had an engineer booked for this morning, eight till twelve, they didn't come, and you'd taken the day off for it. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did you get any text or call this morning about the appointment, a delay or a change?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Nothing at all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the appointment was for the new fibre installation, not a repair?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The installation, yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Bear with me while I check the engineer schedule.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks for waiting. The appointment was cancelled by the field team at seven this morning because the van broke down, and the text to you failed to send. That was our mistake, not yours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So what now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm going to rebook it myself. The field team runs the engineer diaries, but I'll stay as the owner of your case until the installation is done. I can offer tomorrow morning, eight till twelve, or Saturday morning. Which suits you better?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Saturday, I can't take another day off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Saturday it is. One moment while I lock that slot in.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience. That's booked for Saturday, eight till twelve, and I've marked it as priority so it goes first on the route. I've also added a twenty-pound credit to your account for today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. That's something at least.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll ring you on Friday afternoon myself to confirm the engineer and the time window, so you're not left guessing again.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you got the confirmation text for Saturday on your phone now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's just come through.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. So Saturday is confirmed, the credit is applied, and I'll call you Friday. Does that resolve everything for today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Tobias, and again, I'm sorry about this morning.
